'''Oralie''' (Japanese: '''オトネ''' ''Otone'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP021|Ya See We Want An Evolution!]]''.

She is the younger sister of [[Haley]] and is also a member of the [[B-Button League]]. As a member of the league, she aims to make her {{p|Magikarp}} the strongest Pokémon without having to evolve it.

|desc=Oralie's {{p|Magikarp}} appeared in ''[[DP021|Ya See We Want An Evolution!]]'', where he was part of the [[B-Button League]], a group of {{pkmn|Coordinator}}s that do not [[Evolution|evolve]] their Pokémon. After the group met Oralie and [[Haley]], Magikarp and {{p|Feebas}} jumped out the water, showing off their beauty. Then, {{an|Dawn}} battled Magikarp with her {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}} to see how strong the Fish Pokémon is. Magikarp managed to dodge Piplup's attacks and quickly knocked him out with one strong Tackle. Ash battled him using his {{AP|Pikachu}}; the battle was eventually called off for lunch.

Suddenly, {{TRT}} grabbed Magikarp and Feebas so they could evolve them into a {{p|Gyarados}} and {{p|Milotic}} with their new [[Team Rocket's mechas|mecha]]. Pikachu tried to use {{m|Thunderbolt}} to break them out, but was captured as well. The trio attempted to evolve them but the machine did not work, after which Pikachu used {{m|Iron Tail}} to break them out and destroy the mecha. Along with Feebas, Magikarp battled Team Rocket, using Tackle alongside Feebas's {{m|Ice Beam}}, which sent Team Rocket blasting off.

Magikarp's only known move is {{m|Tackle}}.}}
